card.line: Gilead is a hilly, grassy region east of the Jordan River, good for herds, where Jacob met Laban, tribes settled, and Jephthah and Elijah lived.

moments.title: Laban catches Jacob
moments.text: Jacob ran away toward the hill country of Gilead, and Laban chased him for seven days and caught him there. That night God warned Laban in a dream not to say anything to Jacob, either good or bad.

moments.title: Tribes eye Gilead
moments.text: The Reubenites and Gadites had very large herds and flocks. They looked over Gilead and saw that it was good land for animals.

moments.title: Jephthah becomes leader
moments.text: When the Ammonites made war on Israel, the elders of Gilead brought Jephthah back from the land of Tob, though they had forced him out. The people made him their leader and commander, and he repeated his terms before the LORD at Mizpah.

moments.title: Gilead fights Ephraim
moments.text: Jephthah gathered the men of Gilead and fought Ephraim, and the Gileadites took the crossing places of the Jordan. Jephthah judged Israel six years and was buried in one of the cities of Gilead.

moments.title: Elijah from Gilead
moments.text: Elijah the Tishbite was among the settlers of Gilead. He told King Ahab that there would be no dew or rain in the coming years except at his word.
